Exploitability_explanation:: Thorough search of the codebase found no explicit calls to vulnerable methods `PropertyUtilsBean.getProperty()` or `getNestedProperty()`. The library is likely a transitive dependency and not used directly in active code paths.
No explicit calls to `FileBackedOutputStream` were found in the codebase. The vulnerability requires usage of this specific component to trigger insecure temporary file creation.
No explicit calls to `com.google.common.io.Files.createTempDir()` were found. Mockito uses standard Java or internal utilities for temporary file management instead of the vulnerable Guava API.

While `assertj-core` is a dependency used in tests, the specific vulnerable XML assertion APIs (`isXmlEqualTo`, `xmlPrettyFormat`) are not called anywhere in the repository. Standard assertions are used, which are not affected by this XXE flaw.
